notes:
• New Community hub: friends, real-time online presence, friend code, profile customization, 1:1 direct chat with quoted replies, quick room sharing (COOP and Friendly), and overlay notifications with soft audio alerts.
• Opponent Tactical X-Ray: view formation, starters, sub-tactic, and individual instructions before kickoff (Pro + Scout).
• Official connection verdict and Real Server Ranking by IP: check real input delay (IDELAY), match Hz, freezes, opponent Wi-Fi/Ethernet link, and the best analyzed server IPs per region.
• Redesigned My Squad tactical board with official eFootball MiniCards, ? cards for empty slots, and scrollable formation tabs.
• Fixed card animations (Show Time, 2027 Epics, and Big Time), additional player skills, and live club inventory updates.
• Match chat with manual or automatic acceptance, automatic Steam and Xbox PC nickname switching, and stability fixes for match summaries and Xbox PC.

eft_match.notes:
IMPORTANT: Version 3.1.0 introduces the new Community hub (Friends, Online Presence, and Direct Chat), automatic Steam and Xbox PC nickname switching, match chat with manual acceptance, and the new official MatchDesk Scout installer.

To update, visit the Customer Portal at matchdesk.com.br, download the new MatchDesk Scout 3.1.0 installer, and run it normally.

Your license, nicknames, and notes stay saved automatically. Starting with this version, future updates will run 100% automatically inside the app.
